'''2003 Quebec Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship in Montreal (13 April 2003). [[Raphael Asselin]] was the qualifier.<ref name="pc-intl03">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040621085705/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/2003/intlevents.htm Nationals and Provincials (International Events)], swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 21 June 2004.</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Montreal
* '''Dates:''' 13 April 2003<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Venue:''' University of Quebec, Montreal<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Time:''' 9am<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Fee:''' $5<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Tournament director:''' Patrick Dinelle<ref name="pc-intl03" />
* '''Qualifier:''' [[Raphael Asselin]]<ref name="pc-intl03" />
